description: This file contains unit tests for browser host inspection functions, including parsing browser version strings and resolving Chrome executable paths on different platforms. It uses 'vitest' for testing and imports functions from 'browser-host-inspection.js'.

methods.name: parseBrowserMajorVersion
methods.description: Parses the major version number from a browser version string.

methods.name: resolveGoogleChromeExecutableForPlatform
methods.description: Determines the Google Chrome executable path for a given platform, classifying beta and unstable builds as prerelease.
